"body": "Closes #46 Tickets were a special case of a more general thing. The review document now has a `sources` array: tickets, PRs, PR comments, commits, and transcripts. Version 1 still reads old `tickets` and stores them as ticket sources. Prose cites a source with ordinary markdown, `[text](source:id)`. `validate` fails on an unknown id the same way it fails on missing hunk coverage. Serve still starts. The UI renders the mark, a hover card, and a Sources row under What. PR comments copy author and body. A comment with path, side, and line is pinned on the live git diff through Pierre `lineAnnotations`. Several comments on one line stack. A pin that no longer matches git is flagged, never replaced. Comments hide behind a header toggle (`c`). Clicking a citation to a pinned comment still opens that line and shows the quote. The JSON schema the agent writes no longer has `tickets`. The parser keeps the old field so existing documents still load. Browser-tested: overview citations and hover cards, the Sources row, stacked comment pins on a group diff, the Comments toggle, jump-from-citation with comments hidden, and `c` to show them again. [Overview with a ticket citation hover card and Sources row](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-31847959-9f14-42b1-b01a-bc407c9a598f/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Foverview_ticket_citation_hover.webp) [Group diff with two stacked PR comments on one line](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-31847959-9f14-42b1-b01a-bc407c9a598f/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fgroup_stacked_pr_comments.webp) [sources_citations_comments_toggle_and_jump.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-31847959-9f14-42b1-b01a-bc407c9a598f/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fsources_citations_comments_toggle_and_jump.mp4) Posted by Cursor Grok 4.6 [cursor-grok-4.6] To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
